item.title: McDonald's CEO is getting roasted for his 'Big Arch' review. Think you could do better running things? Take this quiz!
item.description: McDonald's CEO is getting lots of grief for his "Big Arch" burger review. Do you think you could do a better job? Try your hand at this quiz.

item.title: When my daughter was diagnosed with autism at age 2, I never imagined she'd own a business and be a reality TV star
item.description: I shifted my autistic daughter's education to life skills. At 27, Abbey Romeo is a business owner and part of Netflix's "Love on the Spectrum."

item.title: Millennium hires one of Citadel's longtime stockpickers
item.description: Daniel Mazur traded for Ken Griffin's Citadel for nearly a decade.

item.title: How Big Tech data centers become a military target during the war in Iran
item.description: Middle East drone attacks on Amazon data centers during the Iran conflict underscore the vulnerability of critical tech infrastructure in warfare.

item.title: Pentagon official details the 'holy cow' moments that sparked rift with Anthropic
item.description: Pentagon R&D chief Emil Michael said comments Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei made during a meeting at the Pentagon set off alarm bells.

item.title: Billy Joel just sold his Long Island estate for a total of $35 million — $14 million under the original asking price
item.description: Billy Joel sold the sprawling waterfront estate that he first spotted while harvesting oysters for minimum wage as a young man.

item.title: Only 13 Saks Fifth Avenue locations will remain after the latest wave of store closures
item.description: Saks Global announced it will close another 12 Saks Fifth Avenue locations and three Neiman Marcus stores as it navigates bankruptcy.

item.title: These companies want their tariff money back from the Trump administration
item.description: FedEx is the latest company to sue for a tariff refund. It filed its suit after IEEPA tariffs were overturned by SCOTUS and joins Costco and others.

item.title: Panama City wants Elon Musk's Boring Company to build a tunnel beneath its famous canal
item.description: Panama City is vying for a free tunnel beneath the Panama Canal from Elon Musk's Boring Company. Its mayor outlined his vision for the proposal.

item.title: Alphabet CEO could earn up to $692M under a new pay package linked to Waymo
item.description: Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai's new pay package ties his compensation to the performance of Waymo and Wing, signaling their growing importance.
